Lead end-to-end transformation projects, from opportunity identification, process assessment, business case development, solution design, implementation, testing, deployment, and post-implementation evaluation. 2. Work closely with Supply Chain, Logistics, Warehousing, Manufacturing, Planning, IT, Finance, and other departments to identify opportunities for process improvement and automation. 4. Establish project objectives, timelines, milestones, resource requirements, budgets, deliverables, and measurable success criteria. 5. Lead cross-functional project teams, manage external vendors and system providers, and ensure timely delivery of project objectives. 6. Oversee User Acceptance Testing (UAT), system integration testing, data migration validation, parallel runs, go-live readiness, user training, and post-implementation stabilization. 7. Develop change management and user adoption strategies to ensure sustainable implementation of new systems and processes. B. Systems Implementation and Optimization 1. Evaluate existing business processes and identify operational gaps, inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and opportunities for digital transformation. 2. Lead implementation or enhancement initiatives involving Supply Chain Logistics systems 3. Ensure system solutions address actual operational requirements rather than simply automating existing inefficient processes. 4. Identify opportunities for further system enhancement, process simplification, integration, and automation. 5. Monitor post-implementation performance and ensure that expected business benefits are realized and sustained. C. Operational Effectiveness, Efficiency, and Continuous Improvement 1. Identify, quantify, and prioritize transformation opportunities based on business impact, implementation feasibility, cost, and return on investment. 2. Establish baseline operational performance and measurable improvement targets before implementing transformation initiatives. 3. Drive initiatives that achieve measurable process improvements and operational excellence in warehouse operations. 4. Conduct root cause analysis, process mapping, workflow redesign, and performance evaluation. 5. Quantify project benefits through productivity improvements, cost savings, cost avoidance, return on investment, and other relevant operational KPIs. 6. Present project results and recommendations to senior management, supported by actual data and documented business improvements. D. Artificial Intelligence (AI) Utilization and Optimization 1. Spearhead the organization's adoption and effective utilization of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and other relevant AI-powered business solutions. 2. Identify practical AI use cases across departments that can improve productivity, automate repetitive tasks, enhance analytical capabilities, and support faster decision-making. 3. Lead AI-driven transformation initiatives 4. Evaluate and pilot AI solutions through proof-of-concept projects, feasibility assessments, and controlled implementation. 5. Establish measurable business objectives and productivity targets for AI-related initiatives. 6. Develop practical AI utilization guidelines, training programs, and adoption strategies for employees and department heads. 7. Coordinate with IT, Information Security, and relevant stakeholders to ensure appropriate AI governance, data privacy, cybersecurity, and responsible AI usage. 8. Continuously assess emerging AI technologies and recommend solutions with clear business value. E. Stakeholder Management and Change Leadership 1. Partner with department heads and process owners to align transformation initiatives with business priorities. 2. Facilitate workshops, project reviews, and process improvement discussions. 3. Manage resistance to change and promote a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 4. Provide regular progress reports, risk assessments, project updates, and business benefit realization reports to senior management. 5. Develop internal capabilities through knowledge transfer, coaching, and training on digital transformation and AI utilization. Positive User.com est une plateforme de marketing automation multicanal regroupant Customer Data Platform et engagement multicanal. In jouw werk komen verschillende onderdelen van de secundaire engineering samen. Van beveiligings- en besturingssystemen tot interfacekasten, kabelvoorzieningen en telecom- en SCADA-oplossingen. Je overziet de technische samenhang, vertaalt projecteisen naar ontwerpen en zorgt dat de verschillende onderdelen goed op elkaar aansluiten.
